# GDT554 — die Bedeutungen halten, aber die langen Satzschablonen fehlen

Status: `PASS_78_STATEMENT_TEMPLATE_ATLAS__ZERO_EXACT_CONTEXT_CONTRADICTIONS`

## Ergebnis

Der GDT553-Leser wurde in alle 78 bereits freigegebenen Aussagen zurückgelegt.
Alle 149 Zielvorkommen treffen ihr exaktes Rezept und genau eine bereits
eingetragene Kontextlesung. Darunter liegen alle 23 später reparierten Karten.
Es musste keine Bedeutung geglättet oder neu erfunden werden.

Die horizontale Grammatik ist klein auf der Ebene der Zustandsbewegung, aber
nicht auf der Ebene ganzer Sätze:

- 546 Ereignisse verwenden 18 Aktions-/Argument-Steckplatzbewegungen;
- die vier häufigsten Bewegungen decken 360/546 Ereignisse ab;
- 16 der 18 Bewegungen kommen in beiden Registern vor;
evidence.scope_result: This returns an existing reader to admitted statements and checks internal consistency; it does not test independently varying external structures.

# GDT744 — historical microfield channel bridge

## Outcome

GDT744 turns part of the inherited generic renderer into explicit historical
record fields without pretending to know the missing substance names.

Across all 202 cached targets, 140 microfields are fully bounded inside radius
five and 62 are censored on at least one side. Sixteen exact-target/channel
templates recur on at least two fully bounded pages with different anchors.
They cover 80 target occurrences: 47 fully bounded F3 cases and 33 censored F2
applications. Combining these field readings with GDT743's 59 target-specific
readings yields 95 context-specific occurrences, 36 more than before.

This is not a translation. Confirmed lexemes and plaintext clauses remain zero.

## What the renderer can now say
evidence.scope_result: It bridges historical field channels around cached targets, but does not supply independent external referents or field substitutions held against them.

evidence.quote:
# GDT793 report — `okal` whole-record candidate discriminator

## Result

GDT793 selects one deliberately bold but replaceable working meaning for the
exact complete form `okal`:

```text
okal = KENNSTELLEN-/SYSTEMEINTRAGSCODE
       [C0 working renderer, not confirmed plaintext]
```

In a ring this is displayed as a ring-position or system-entry code; in the
f82 pool drawing it is displayed as a station/system-entry code. The meaning
is not exported to `ok`, `al`, `okaly`, `okaldy`, `qokal` or any other longer
or shorter form.

This is more specific than GDT792's structural tag. It says that `okal` most
likely classifies or codes a member/slot of an organised set. It does **not**
say “go to this target”, identify one unique named member, or mean a numeral.
An entirely opaque productive renderer remains a live null, so the confidence
stays C0.

The guarded build passes 181 checks and two byte-identical replays.
evidence.scope_result: The masked whole-record test challenges owner/address interpretations, not GDT113's proposed external record-template alignment.

successor_conclusion: The returned successors refine internal templates, historical field channels, or whole-record owner hypotheses. None actually executes GDT113's proposed alignment to independently varying external structures with held field substitutions. They therefore do not close that route, but they also do not justify reopening isolated host/content tests.
recommendation: Treat a future provenance-clean external-template alignment as an extension of the existing HF architecture question, with GDT113 as the page/register-conditioned branch and GDT298 as the joint-form branch. Keep it distinct only at the preregistered predictor level; do not create a new semantic dossier or claim semantic readiness.
minimum_changed_input: Freeze repeated record templates, an independently varying external structure, source-bound field correspondences, and held records. Require gains beyond page/register, string, edge, and template-frequency controls.
